title: Advance nonconformance
purpose: Complete the next available step using the fields required by the issue’s current status.

sections.title: Who can change this record
paragraphs: Any lab staff member can open a nonconformance, read it and add notes/evidence, including after closure. Only its assigned owner or an admin, reviewer, approver or project manager role can edit details or drive workflow. Opening a record does not by itself give the opener management rights. Staff selectors list active non-client accounts, ordered by username, with full name and username when available.

sections.title: Current step and navigation
paragraphs: The page identifies the NC number, title and current status. Its heading and submit label change with the current status. It opens only the next step for a nonclosed issue; unavailable steps redirect to details with an error. Forward forms preload existing findings, owner and due date. Empty optional forward-step values preserve current values rather than clearing them. Use Edit when an allowed field must be cleared.

items.label: Owner
items.description: Required active non-client account; prefilled if already assigned.

items.label: Due
items.description: Optional target date; prefilled from the issue. This transition does not check it against discovery.

items.label: Note
items.description: Optional timeline explanation.

items.label: Start investigation
items.description: Records assignment/due changes and moves to Investigating.

sections.title: Record root cause and disposition: Investigating to Corrective action

items.label: Root cause
items.description: Required nonblank cause text, using existing text or a new entry.

items.label: Disposition
items.description: Required choice: Continue work, no effect on results; Continue work, qualify results; Repeat or re-prepare work; Hold work pending decision; Reject or discard affected work; Other (explain in the note).

items.label: Disposition note
items.description: Required when Other is chosen; otherwise optional.

items.label: Due
items.description: Optional updated target date; blank preserves the existing value.

items.label: Note
items.description: Optional timeline note.

items.label: Record root cause and disposition
items.description: Records findings and moves to Corrective action. Does not apply that disposition automatically to linked work.

sections.title: Submit for verification: Corrective action to Verification

items.label: Corrective action
items.description: Required nonblank account of action taken, using existing text or a new entry.

items.label: Due
items.description: Optional target-date update; blank preserves current due.

items.label: Note
items.description: Optional timeline note.

items.label: Submit for verification
items.description: Records action and moves to Verification; it does not assign a separate verifier.

sections.title: Verify and close: Verification to Closed

items.label: Verification
items.description: Required nonblank explanation of how the action was shown to work.

items.label: Closure note
items.description: Optional closure narrative.

items.label: Reference
items.description: Maximum 160 characters. A new closure reference or Evidence file is required; evidence from earlier timeline events alone does not satisfy this step.

items.label: Evidence file
items.description: Optional when a Reference is given; otherwise required supporting attachment.

items.label: Note
items.description: Optional timeline note distinct from the stored closure note.

items.label: Verify and close
items.description: Records verification and any closure note, the closing actor and system time, and changes status to Closed. Closing removes Past due state but retains the due date.

sections.title: Evidence files
paragraphs: Attach a nonempty PDF, PNG, JPEG, TXT or CSV no larger than 10 MiB. TXT/CSV must be UTF-8; PDF and image bytes must match the extension. Evidence is optional unless a step requires a reference or file. Downloads are attachments, not inline previews. File links show name, size and the first 12 SHA-256 checksum characters. No file indicates no stored attachment. Staff can download equipment/nonconformance evidence; training evidence is limited to the person and lead roles. A correction is a new record: an earlier attachment is not copied automatically, so attach evidence again if it belongs on the new record.

sections.title: Saving and errors
paragraphs: An asterisk marks required fields. Cancel returns to the parent record or list without saving. Success opens the saved record with a confirmation. Validation errors appear above the form and beside affected fields; correct them and submit again. Text input remains after validation errors; select an evidence file again if necessary. Dates use year-month-day; date and time fields use the deployment time zone.

sections.title: Concurrent changes and history
paragraphs: Saving locks and rechecks the revision you opened. If another user changed the record, reload it, review the latest values and enter your change again. Failed validation writes no partial change. Successful changes and attributed audit events commit together.

sections.title: Workflow and limits
paragraphs: The fixed flow is Open, Investigating, Corrective action, Verification, Closed. Steps cannot be skipped. Verification can return to Corrective action; Closed can reopen to Investigating, each with a reason. Severity and disposition are recorded choices; the system does not infer them. A linked issue or a disposition such as Hold or Qualify does not automatically hold a batch, qualify a result, retire equipment, alter stock or block report release. Apply any separate operational controls explicitly. There is no required independent verifier rule in this workflow; the owner or lead can verify and close.

sections.title: Form dialog controls
paragraphs: With enhancement enabled, the form opens in a dialog, including when its URL is opened directly. Without enhancement it remains a normal page. While loading or saving, controls are disabled to avoid duplicate submissions; focus moves to the first invalid field or first editable field when ready. Saving successfully navigates to the resulting record.

items.label: Maximize / Restore size
items.description: Expand the dialog to full screen or restore its normal size. Small screens use a full-screen layout.

items.label: Cancel / Close form / Escape
items.description: Close an unchanged form. When opened over another page, return focus to its opening control; when opened directly, return to the Cancel destination. Clicking outside the dialog does not close it.

items.label: Keep editing / Discard changes
items.description: After an input change, attempting to leave asks Discard your unsaved changes? Keep editing retains the form; Discard changes closes or follows the requested destination without saving. Escape during that prompt keeps editing.

items.label: Try again
items.description: Shown after a failed initial load. Retry loading the form. Save/connection errors keep the current input and show an error so you can retry the submission. Validation errors replace the form with its submitted values and field messages; files may need selecting again.
